note: platformCleanup: cleanupAndExit is an operand of two '||' conditions deciding whether to clean up iptables/ipvs and nftables rules regardless of the active mode.

resetConfigDir: isDryRun gates real deletion vs print-only for both dirsToClean and filesToClean (repeated 'if !isDryRun {delete} else {print}' pairs) - same dryRun-flag pattern seen earlier in postupgrade.go.

fromConfigMap: mustExist is an operand of '!mustExist && (apierrors.IsNotFound(err) || apierrors.IsForbidden(err))' deciding whether a missing ConfigMap is tolerated (nil,nil) or returned as an error.
detectUnstableVersionError: allowExperimentalUpgrades and allowRCUpgrades both gate early 'return nil' guard clauses controlling whether an unstable/RC version error is suppressed.
Textbook case: WriteKubeletConfigFiles branches on dryRun twice (if/else, then two guarded print blocks).
RemoveKubeletArgsFromFile: if dryRun { print-only; return } else { real backup+edit }.
makeContainerStats: updateCPUNanoCoreUsage picks between p.getAndUpdateContainerUsageNanoCores vs p.getContainerUsageNanoCores via if/else - two distinct cache-update-vs-read strategies.

testParamRefCase: selectorIsSet is the 'else if selectorIsSet' branch (after nameIsSet's if) selecting which ParamRef selector field to populate for the test scenario - a 5-bool-parameter test helper, each genuinely branched on.

convertObjectToUnstructured: includeFieldSelector and includeLabelSelector each gate an 'if includeX && obj...Selector != nil' block deciding whether to include that selector's data in the CEL-evaluable map.

cacheKeyBuilder.addBool(value bool): if value { b = 1 } serializes an arbitrary caller-supplied bool into a cache-key byte - value is data being encoded, not a behavior-mode flag, so it doesn't fit the call-site-confusion problem Remove Flag Argument targets even though it mechanically matches the rule.

RunTestConsistentList: consistentReadsSupported is referenced in an 'if consistentReadsSupported' inside a nested validateResponseRV closure (captured, not shadowed - the closure never redeclares it) - confirms the checker correctly follows captures into nested closures rather than false-negativing on them.

getPodCgroupPath: podOnCgroupv2 in 'if !podOnCgroupv2 { rootPath += "/"+subsystem }' - selects cgroup v1 vs v2 root path layout; same param repeats this pattern in getCgroupMemLimitPath/getCgroupCPULimitPath/getCgroupCPURequestPath in this file.
getExpectedMemLimitString: podOnCgroupv2 is an operand of 'if podOnCgroupv2 && expectedMemLimitString == "0"' to special-case cgroup v2's 'max' spelling for unlimited memory.
ScaleResource: 'if !wait { return nil }' early-returns to skip WaitForControlledPodsRunning - classic optional-wait flag argument.
findKubeletServiceName: 'if running { cmdLine = append(cmdLine, "--state=running") }' toggles whether the systemctl query is restricted to running units.
gomegaAssertion: fatal picks between gtypes.GomegaTestingT(tCtx) (fail-fast) and assertTestingT{tCtx} (continue-on-failure) via 'if !fatal' - two distinct testingT implementations.
